conceptZh: 愛逞強的玩具戰士與發條軍艦拔河，繩扣突然鬆開讓雙方跌坐彈跳，震出的甲板零件排成「軍」，戰士最後登艦敬禮。
object: A chunky toy warrior, an elastic mooring strap, and one wind-up toy naval patrol boat with detachable navy-blue deck pieces.
morph: The boat's flat deck pieces become the exact strokes of 軍: a broad 冖 above a clearly formed 車, with its central vertical extending below the lowest horizontal.
creativeAngle: 把拔河變成戰士想拉軍艦靠岸卻被反拉的逞強笑話；跌坐的震動直接拋出字形零件，最後登艦敬禮具體呼應「海軍」，不用增加軍團人潮。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D cartoon with one original chunky toy warrior: molded limbs, an oversized helmet, foam sword, round shield, enormous bravado and very little coordination. His sole companion is a wind-up toy naval patrol boat with a rounded hull, anchor emblem and springy stern bumper. Use a pale sandy background, a shallow turquoise water strip along the bottom, and saturated navy-blue glyph pieces. Fixed frontal camera; soft, bright lighting.

0.0–1.4s: The warrior wants to haul the boat ashore. He points proudly with his foam sword, swings too enthusiastically, spins once and accidentally catches the boat's elastic mooring strap under his shield. The off-screen voice says the first “軍” as the taut strap lifts the boat's bundled, stroke-shaped deck pieces into view at center.

1.4–3.2s: He grabs one end with both hands; the other stays visibly clamped in the boat's bow cleat. Its wind-up paddle churns away from shore. They pull against each other: his heels skid, his cheeks redden, and the boat leans backward on its stern bumper. He plants one foot triumphantly—then slides another whole body length. Keep both ends and the stretching middle visible.

3.2–4.8s: The bow cleat pops open! The warrior flies backward onto his padded bottom while the boat rocks backward onto its springy stern. One soft synchronized BONK launches the loose deck pieces upward into the central display plane. They settle directly into the correct Traditional Chinese 軍: broad 冖 above 車, its inner box, horizontal bars and uninterrupted central vertical precisely aligned. Say the second “軍” exactly as the last piece seats at 4.6s. The warrior bounces once with a dizzy grin.

4.8–8.0s: Hold the completed 軍 perfectly still, centered, uncropped and about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Below it, the boat rebounds gently to shore; the warrior hops aboard, raises his shield and gives a proud naval salute. Say “海軍” exactly during this boarding-and-saluting action. His helmet then slips over his eyes; he nudges it up, still saluting, entirely below the strokes.

Warm off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin voice, slowly and distinctly: “軍、軍、海軍” (ㄐㄩㄣ、ㄐㄩㄣ、ㄏㄞˇ ㄐㄩㄣ). Read exactly these syllables and tones, with a short pause between utterances; stop after the word. Only 軍 appears as text. No subtitles, logos, watermark or extra dialogue; quiet elastic squeaks and cushioned bonks support the voice.
